svg.title: IconTypeCookBook
svg.desc: explorer.html tree type marks (the .ti glyphs in its ICON map: cook / recipe / ing). Each mockup glyph is several <path>s: a stroked outline plus a fill-only accent detail. The stroked outlines are concatenated verbatim below; the fill-only details are dropped, since a StreamGeometry is one single-color stroked path and cannot carry a second fill. What is lost is the cookbook's accent bookmark tab, the recipe's accent corner dot and the ingredient's accent-wash top face - decoration, not the silhouette that identifies the glyph.
